summary: Aura Biosciences filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026, reporting the appointment of Natalie Holles as CEO, President, and Class I director, effective April 30, 2026, succeeding founder Elisabet de los Pinos, who departed from all roles. The filing details Ms. Holles' extensive industry experience but provides no material terms, board recommendation, or compensation specifics. This constitutes an abrupt CEO departure and replacement, triggering Item 5.02. No transaction price, premium, or deal structure is involved. Watch for potential strategic shifts under new leadership, though no immediate catalyst is indicated.
